metadata.title: TechToJob — Developer and tech company community
metadata.description: Connect with real tech opportunities. Showcase your talent in live coding tournaments, access direct job openings, and join the great TechToJob community.

hero.title: The <teal>developer</teal> community that connects with <teal>tech companies</teal>
hero.description: Join projects, tournaments, and networking channels within our Discord. Show what you can do, build experience, and create connections so that IT job opportunities find you.

step1.title: Join the community
step1.description: Join Discord instantly without registration forms. Explore channels, projects, and conversations that interest you most.

step2.title: Participate and showcase your skills
step2.description: Share your projects, solve challenges, join tournaments, and take part in community conversations.

step3.title: Let your work speak for you
step3.description: Your participation showcases how you work and what you can do. You don't need to wait for a job opening to start getting noticed.

step4.title: Opportunities appear
step4.description: When a company searches for a profile like yours, they can find you within the community, see your work, and reach out directly.

talent.subtitle: Let companies find you
talent.description: Share your tech stack, skill level, and availability on your profile. You don't need to be a senior. Community companies can learn about your experience without an automated filter deciding if you deserve to be seen.

companies.subtitle: Get to know developers before interviewing them
companies.description: Post the profile you're looking for and explore community talent. Here you can discover their projects, how they solve problems, and their experience before reaching out.
companies.note: Find people for what they actually know how to do, not just what their resume says.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.subtitle: Learn, compete, and build your portfolio
tournaments.description1: Join open challenges, submit your solution, and receive an evaluation with public criteria. Each tournament lets you learn, add a project to your portfolio, and have something tangible to showcase in an interview.
tournaments.description2: Winning projects are launched into production. The website you are currently viewing was also developed during one of our tournaments.

step1.title: Challenge Launch
step1.description: Technical requirements, base design, and clear deadlines open to all skill levels.

step2.title: Project Development
step2.description: Build your solution, solve real challenges, and submit your project repository.
points: Freedom in code approach and structure

step3.title: Community Evaluation
step3.description: Community review with transparent metrics on code quality, accessibility, and UI.

step4.title: Live Deployment
step4.description: The project ships to production, giving you verifiable real-world experience.

community.title: Our Community
community.p1: Connect with professionals in your field, share knowledge, and discover new job opportunities.
community.p2: Participate in topic channels, build connections, and resolve your questions with people walking similar paths to yours.
community.p3: By being active in the community, your job search changes: instead of constantly chasing opportunities, opportunities start coming to you.
community.p4: Discover job openings shared by the community, recommend talent, and stay close to the companies and professionals that make up TechToJob.

card.phrase: Area-specific channels with industry peers providing support and sharing job openings
card.footer: Direct peer-to-peer networking and early job opening alerts

javier.name: Javier M.
javier.quote: I was tired of sending out resumes without knowing what happened next. Here I was able to showcase some of my projects, share them with the community, and start making connections with companies.

marcos.name: Marcos V.
marcos.quote: I finally found a place where I can demonstrate how I code and solve problems, instead of depending solely on how my resume looks.

ana.name: Ana R.
ana.quote: Participating in tournaments allowed me to tackle more complex projects, gain hands-on experience, and have something concrete to show when looking for professional opportunities.

sofia.name: Sofía L.
sofia.quote: I stopped relying solely on sending CVs. Here I can participate in the community, showcase what I can do, and connect with peers and opportunities in the industry.

newsSection.title: News
newsSection.subtitle: Updates, articles, and insights from our community and the tech ecosystem

item1.title: How the new TechToJob landing page was born
item1.description: This landing page was created as a result of our second development tournament. Several participants worked on the same challenge, and the winning project shipped to production to become the new face of TechToJob.

item2.title: Why are companies seeking new ways to assess IT talent?
item2.description: We analyze how tech hiring processes are shifting and why demonstrating skills through projects, technical challenges, and real-world scenarios is becoming increasingly essential.

item3.title: Building in public: how to gain visibility in the tech community
item3.description: Sharing projects, progress, and insights can help you build professional credibility before landing your next job. Discover how being active in a community opens new connections and opportunities.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.headline: Don't miss what's happening in the community.
newsletter.p1: Receive new tournaments, job opportunities, projects, and insights to grow in tech directly in your inbox.
newsletter.p2: No spam, no noise; only what helps you take the next step in your career.

form.success: Thanks for subscribing! We'll keep you updated with the latest news.

finalCta.title: The place where tech talent meets.
finalCta.p1: Stop wasting time sending resumes that get stuck in filters. Join the community, stand out by showcasing what you can build, and connect with fresh job opportunities.
finalCta.p2: There are already many developers sharing code, tackling challenges, and competing in tournaments. This community never stops growing, all that's missing is you.

footer.tagline: Where tech talent demonstrates its potential and connects with job opportunities.
